records.name: Dimension Cannon
records.effect: Short-range six-hit timespace Ki wave that launches and guard-breaks.

records.name: Victory Cannon
records.effect: Fires a Ki wave and uses recoil to propel the user backward.

records.name: Force Shield
records.effect: Deploys a barrier that cancels Ki waves; holding the input consumes Ki to maintain it.

records.name: Blaster Meteor
records.effect: Creates a wide sphere of Ki blasts around the user, hitting up to eight times and launching nearby opponents.

notes: Dimension Cannon and Force Shield are cast-character skills in the current documentation. Victory Cannon is explicitly obtainable by the Future Warrior in PQ54, so it is CaC-usable. Blaster Meteor is explicitly learned by the Future Warrior through Broly's first Training Lesson, so UF is false because the route is instructor training rather than a PQ Ultimate Finish.
